title: E-invoicing digital reporting
text:
This consultation seeks views from businesses, agents, software providers and other stakeholders on the opportunities, risks, costs and safeguards associated with E-Invoicing Digital Reporting.

 The consultation forms part of the government’s wider work to modernise tax administration and follows the publication of the e-invoicing implementation roadmap. It is intended to gather evidence and stakeholder views to inform future policy development.

 The government has not taken any decisions on whether E-Invoicing Digital Reporting should be introduced or how any future approach might operate.
